stable_policy_precondition: Board/chip/special selectors fixed during a stream. Changing special flag mid-loop was not reconstructed.
critical_limits: Frame kind is not an acceptance verdict.
No CRC verification at recovered boundary; low five bits merely extracted.
Nonce result only raw payload/job-slot bits, no job validity or hash/share check.
Exact T21 model-to-driver mapping is not established.
One per-chain loop body, not complete scheduler/condition-wait/receiver thread.
Original ring pop helpers execute only in the reference interpreter; new adapter uses its own bounded buffer.
New defensive checks and output structure are not vendor ABI.
